ResearchProjectDef.label: basic magic storage
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a magic storage network with a control core, storage units, storage conduits and receivers. Unlock auto-restocking shelves, apparel adapters, cosmic workbenches and construction supply units.

ResearchProjectDef.label: material supply technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build material suppliers and fuel suppliers to deliver supplies directly from the magic storage network to transporters and fuel-powered buildings.

ResearchProjectDef.label: warp technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build caravan teleporters to form caravans directly on the world map, supplied by the magic storage network.
